effect_description_eng:
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] Until the end of your opponent's turn, 2 of your green and/or black Digimon gain ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.).
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When another Digimon becomes suspended, you may unsuspend this Digimon.
xros_req: [Digivolve] Lv.5 w/[Rapidmon] in name or Lv.5 2-color w/Green: Cost 4
